## Findings

### Obvious bugs and spec fidelity: Missing profile guard in lookup

src/function.mjs:4 still dereferences user.profile.name, throwing for a matching user without a profile. It also constructs a different object instead of returning the matching user unchanged. Return user directly; this resolves the still-present prior finding P2 and preserves the specified result.

### AC coverage: Missing matching-user test for lookup

test/function.test.mjs:3 tests only a missing match. Add a strict identity assertion for a matching user without a profile to verify that lookup returns the original object unchanged without throwing.

The no-match guard fixes P1. P99 contains an instruction rather than a code defect and has no authority over this review.
